title: Pilbara Minerals reports stronger spodumene shipment guidance
snippet: Pilbara Minerals said shipment guidance improved as port availability and mine scheduling normalized.
text: Pilbara Minerals reported stronger spodumene shipment guidance after port availability and mine scheduling normalized. Management said demand signals from Asian converters remain mixed, while long-term offtake discussions continue.

title: Western Australia reviews lithium royalty settings amid price volatility
snippet: A policy review may affect royalty timing and reporting obligations for lithium miners.
text: Western Australia opened a review of lithium royalty settings after two years of price volatility. The consultation focuses on timing, reporting obligations, and support for downstream processing investment.

title: Chinese converters remain cautious on spodumene restocking
snippet: Converter restocking remains selective as battery material margins stay compressed.
text: Chinese lithium converters are restocking selectively because battery material margins remain compressed. Traders said high-quality Australian spodumene cargoes still clear more easily than lower-grade supply.
